note: Hand-authored source of truth for the brand layer. `scripts/sync.mjs` reads this + assets/**.svg and regenerates src/registry.generated.ts (drift-gated, like the icon registry). An art slot is either "pending" or a path relative to assets/. Masters should use `currentColor` for fills so the `mono`/`inverse` tones derive from one file; ship a separate full-color file for the `color` tone.

logos.name: Auterion
logos.brandHue: auterion-blue.700 — oklch(0.520 0.192 259.3). The ramp is anchored at 259.3° on the blue Mission Control and Nemyx already ship (AD-D-015); rung 600 IS that blue. The color mark uses this hue; never substitute a generic blue. Token ref: color.primitive.auterion-blue.700 (semantic `brand` — 700 rather than 600 because 600 carries white text at only 4.18:1).
forbidden: the full color lockup inside dense operational chrome — use the bare mark, mono/inverse, at minSize
over photographic / satellite terrain without a contrast scrim (see brand imagery)

logos.name: Mission Control
logos.context: L3 Operational / L4 Mission-Critical — dark surfaces only; prefer the mono/inverse mark in chrome.
forbidden: the color lockup in the operational toolbar — use the inverse mark
over live map/video without a scrim

logos.name: AuterionSuite
logos.context: L2 Conventional — light default; full-color lockup is appropriate.
forbidden: the full color lockup inside dense operational chrome — use the bare mark, mono/inverse, at minSize

logos.name: AuterionOS
logos.context: L2 device-admin — light/dark; device + onboarding surfaces.

logos.name: Nemyx
logos.context: L4 Mission-Critical — swarm command, keyboard-first, and the surface designed for a tablet held outdoors. It is the first real consumer of the `sunlight` theme, which ships in the token set with none today. Dark is its default and light is shipped (AD-D-016).
forbidden: the full color lockup inside dense operational chrome — use the bare mark, mono/inverse, at minSize
the mark over map or video imagery without a contrast scrim (AD-D-032) — Nemyx already draws a brand watermark straight onto the map
a product hue for identity on the map — the watermark is a tint of the neutral, never an accent
